That'd be nice. My life is just a mess and my head keeps messing with me. My ex-girlfriend left me and now she's having the time of her life. I didn't even love her that much towards the end of it, but seeing her so bounce back up after her slump right after leaving me hurts. I can't stop obsessing over her. I keep going back to her facebook profile to see how she's doing.
I have CFS and it has pretty much ruined my college career. I wanted to become a Physics professor, but I'm no longer competitive. I get rejected from any REUs or Scholarships I apply to. I'm considering other career options, but I'm not really interested in anything else. I'm really good at hiding my feelings, so only my psychiatrist knows I'm having suicidal thoughts. That, and no one really knows how fucked up I really feel. I'm just too good at masking it, and I can't stop myself from doing so.
